name: physics_constants
description: Look up the CODATA 2022 recommended values of the fundamental physical constants by symbol, exact name or keywords: value, standard uncertainty, relative uncertainty, unit, concise notation such as 9.1093837139(28)e-31 and whether the value is exact in the 2019 SI. All 355 constants of NIST's complete listing are bundled in a dated table; every answer names the source and fetch date.

query.description: A symbol (h, m_e, N_A), an exact name, or keywords ("proton mass")

name.description: Exact quantity name as NIST prints it, case-insensitive

list.description: List every constant name and its symbols

catalog.source: CODATA 2022 recommended values (Tiesinga, Mohr, Newell, Taylor), NIST Fundamental Physical Constants complete listing https://physics.nist.gov/cuu/Constants/Table/allascii.txt (public domain), fetched 2026-10-18 by tools/catalog/data/physics_constants.py
